program.name: Do the Splits
program.subject: Flexible & bendy
program.blurb: Front splits and side splits so you can drop your hips and get deeper, strong at the end range and held long.
program.about: Splits, both kinds, so your hips can drop close and you can still drive. One day builds strength at the end range, split-squat holds, Cossacks and active leg lifts, then stretches; the other is a long splits flow, lizard, half splits and the splits themselves, held long. Level II and III hold everything longer.
